_about: Round 18 (2026-11-26): Anthony felt sounds were missing and timing was not perfect, and said yes to a second close look plus frame-exact timing. First round on the new reference video (mitey_vacuum_short_polish_full_silent.mp4). Round 17 was the real-recordings thread's.

variants.label: Second close look
variants.why: After the first plan, Claude goes through the whole video again at 8 pictures per second and adds a sound for every small action that had none.

variants.label: Frame-exact timing
variants.why: For each key moment Claude is shown every single frame around it and picks the exact one. The sound is slid so it starts on that frame.

variants.label: Second look and frame-exact timing
variants.why: Both together: more sounds, each placed on its exact frame.
